notes: Real captured Claude file-creation turn. Claude sends the creation diff with "oldText": null, which the ACP schema declares nullable and optional. The translator once refused that frame as malformed, tore the adapter down mid-turn, and cancelled the tool card before any permission card could render.
The trace is the regression guard for that refusal: a null original side now admits an empty original, so the diff item and the permission request both survive translation.
The account identity carried by _auth/status_update is redacted, and the captured workspace path is rewritten to the shared fixture workspace root.

The capture stops at session/request_permission, so the trace asserts no prompt terminal. The absorbed available_commands_update frames are omitted; they surface no event and carry local machine configuration.
The diff item projects as fileChangeDiff without pair metadata because the conformance resource mapper treats every absolute path as foreign, so no pair is retained.
